system.summary: Papal nunciature cipher: homophonic alphabet of 1- and 2-digit elements (e.g. A = 28|38|8), 1 as null/separator, dotted code groups; key reconstructed by Lasry 2020.
system.notes: Element boundaries are not marked; the split is ambiguous and was resolved with a language model.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary decifrati bound in Francia 3; J. Lestocquoy (ed.), Correspondance du nonce en France Prospero Santa Croce (1552-1554), Acta Nuntiaturae Gallicae 9 (1972); Lasry's key on DECODE R6-R10 (24 Oct 2020)

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched R6-R10 pages, images, 2016 transcriptions, Lasry's key file and a 288-page PDF with the DECODE cookie.
Lasry's reconstructed key (DOC_R*_D320x) applied to the transcriptions with an it-cinquecento beam segmenter (decode.py); R8 matches its interlinear clear.
The attached PDF is Lestocquoy 1972 (Acta Nuntiaturae Gallicae 9); located all five letters by folio (nos. 67, 71, 112, 124, second letter of 23 Dec 1553), cipher passages printed deciphered.
Decrypts of R6, R7, R8, R10 agree with the printed text where the transcription is clean.
R9's three struck-through cipher lines, unprinted, read from the image through the cancellation strokes.
R9 fragments ('l'ar[mata]', 'aviso') fit the clear P.S. written below; the cancelled cipher is that P.S., abandoned.

Re-read R9's cancelled lines at full resolution; long stretches align under the key (Corsica, fortuna, come ne, dove, aviso del Strozzi): the cancelled cipher is the clear P.S. below, not printed in 1972.

outcome.method_basis: All five cipher passages have contemporary decifrati bound in Francia 3 and are printed deciphered in Lestocquoy 1972 (Acta Nuntiaturae Gallicae 9); Lasry's key on DECODE R6-R10 (2020) was applied as a check, and with it the three unprinted cancelled lines of R9 were read as the clear postscript below them.
outcome.notes: Read at the time and printed 1972; Lasry's key on DECODE since 2020. R9's cancelled cipher lines (unprinted) read here as the P.S. Catalogue entry 245 removed, no write-up.
